result.note: Tests the Republic Day 2026 chief guests against earlier years and the office held by António Costa. The FTA announcement was only 'likely', so it is skipped.

questions.prompt: Consider the following pairs of India's Republic Day parade years and their chief guests:
items: 2026 — Ursula von der Leyen and António Costa
questions.ask: How many of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
questions.explain: All three pairs are correct. France's Macron was the chief guest in 2024 and Indonesia's Prabowo in 2025. In January 2026 the EU's two top leaders attended together, marking a shift from big bilateral partners to a bloc.
questions.source: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen and European Council President António Costa attended as guests of honour yesterday.

questions.prompt: António Costa attended India's Republic Day parade in January 2026 as a guest of honour. Which office did he hold at the time?
options: EU High Representative for Foreign Affairs
questions.explain: Costa attended as European Council President, alongside European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen. The two then attended the EU-India Summit in New Delhi the following day.
questions.source: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen and European Council President António Costa attended as guests of honour yesterday.
